built: canonical/runtime/goal_verb_decomposition_v1.py -- parses a goal sentence into (VERB, operand) instead of matching whole sentence patterns. 17 verbs; returns UNSUPPORTED_VERB with the goal text rather than falling through to a generic click.
why_this_was_the_right_build: r130/r131 showed the dominant failure was that 28 of 40 tasks were never attempted. Reading all 130 task files showed the goals are not infinitely varied: ~45 sentence patterns reduce to ~16 verbs times a handful of operand kinds. Hard-coding sentence patterns gives coverage proportional to how many sentences someone wrote; parsing verbs gives coverage proportional to how many verbs the environment offers.

measurement_on_the_same_seeded_random_40.decomposition_coverage_after: 80% (32/40 goals parse to a known verb)

the_honest_reading_of_success_given_atte: this is the correct behaviour of an honest planner, not a regression. The planner now attempts tasks for which it recognises the VERB but has no working implementation of that verb (DRAG on non-box widgets, DRAW, MOVE, SCROLL_TO, SET_SLIDERS on non-slider widgets). Those are counted as attempts and as failures. The previous 5/12 was measured only on the tasks whose whole sentence had been hand-coded, which is a tuned denominator.

the_two_factors_kept_separate.competence: 9/32 = 28% -- when it parses, does the implemented verb work
the_two_factors_kept_separate.consequence: the next gain must come from implementing verbs (competence), not from parsing more sentences (coverage), because coverage is already 80%

what_remains_refused_and_why_that_is_cor.goal: Press the button that correctly denotes how many sides the shape has
what_remains_refused_and_why_that_is_cor.reason: requires counting a rendered shape; the count is visual, not textual
requires multi-step state (open message, forward, choose recipient)

what_remains_refused_and_why_that_is_cor.goal: Close the dialog box by clicking the "x".
what_remains_refused_and_why_that_is_cor.reason: the control is a DIV labelled 'Close'; the verb parser sees CLICK with operand x and the operand does not exist. This is a known operand-modality gap, not a parsing gap
drag target identified by spatial description (top right)
requires a resize drag on a corner handle

what_is_NOT_claimed: that 22.5% is the final reach -- it was measured once, one episode per task, on one 40-task sample
